name: Sableye

attacks.name: Jeweled Gift
attacks.text: Take a random Energy from among {Grass}, {Fire}, {Water}, {Lightning}, {Psychic}, {Fighting}, {Darkness}, and {Metal} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
